title: Structured Utterance Producer qualification and repository admission
summary: Structured Utterance Producer v0.1 closes the generic orchestrator-to-Structured-Utterance pre-flattening seam and has prior executable qualification evidence. On 2026-10-23 it was committed through the Alchemy immutable two-commit Autobuild transport with root integration metadata; acceptance is pending because no receiver receipt exists yet.
invariants: FLATTENED_REPLY_INSUFFICIENT is a successful fail-closed result.
The producer reuses native Structured Utterance semantic objects and does not create a parallel taxonomy.
AI/provider invocation, application authority, effect evaluation and execution remain outside the producer.
A qualified standalone artifact is not portfolio-owned until repository/registry admission succeeds.
Repository admission metadata must not silently change runtime semantics.
The two-commit transport keeps package tree in the parent commit and ready.json as the final commit; the submission branch is immutable after ready.
procedure: Wait for the receiver-owned receipt/result on main; do not merge the transport branch.
Only after PASS/acceptance update portfolio status from standalone candidate to admitted package.

provenance.claim: Standalone producer boundary, fail-closed flattened reply semantics and ownership limits.
Portfolio review records Structured Utterance Producer as pre-flattening intent/lineage closure with owning artifact still to be added to the registry.
